name: Sodden Floor
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-03: Escaping the Grave
description: The floorboards here are rotting and soft, giving way and dropping anyone above into the hole below.
disable: DC 16 Crafting (trained) to reinforce the compromised floorboards.

generalAbilities.name: Crumble
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature walks onto any square containing the sodden floorboards.

Effect All squares with floorboards give way. Each creature in any of the marked squares must attempt a DC 18 Reflex Saving Throw save.

Success The creature moves to the nearest safe square and avoids falling in.

Failure The creature falls 10 feet, takes 5 bludgeoning damage as a result of the fall, and is prone in the hole.
